subject: Post-demo: procurement & hosting alignment
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Bauer <tom.bauer@novusretail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: procurement & hosting alignment

Tom — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so procurement has what they need to move forward.

Recap (30-min demo):
- Demo focused on inference economics for large-scale catalog search and conversational customer support.
- Key asks from your side: deterministic latency under 150ms p95, data isolation for PII, and predictable monthly spend to present to FinOps.

Questions we need answered to recommend the right commercial path:
1) Procurement preference: PO with vendor paperwork (paper SOW + invoice) vs. corporate card/on-demand?
2) Marketplace interest: would you prefer to purchase through your cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace) for consolidated billing?
3) Commitment appetite: are you open to a 12-month committed capacity (Dedicated) vs. on-demand hosted consumption?

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll attach two quick artifacts: an SOW template and a high-level TCO workbook comparing Hosted vs Dedicated for your usage pattern.
- Can you introduce me to the procurement contact and share any vendor intake form or SSOW deadline?
- If procurement prefers PO + SOW, I’ll loop our legal and delivery leads and prepare a draft SOW for review.

Timing: if procurement can confirm payment path this week we can provide a pricing anchor and an estimated start date for a pilot in early Dec.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_template.pdf (stub), Redwood_TCO_hosted_vs_dedicated.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — happy to jump back on a quick call with procurement if it speeds things up.

—
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Tom Bauer <tom.bauer@novusretail.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Novus Retail Procurement <procurement@novusretail.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & hosting alignment

Thanks Jasmine — big thanks to the team for the demo. Quick answers from my side before I loop Procurement: 

- Procurement preference: we typically run vendor contracts via PO + vendor paperwork for anything over $25k annual expected spend. Card charges are OK for proof-of-concepts but not for production commitments.
- Marketplace: we prefer marketplace purchases for ease of internal chargeback, but marketplace pricing/commits sometimes lags direct pricing; we can evaluate both.
- Commitment appetite: we’re open to a 12-month commit for production if the unit economics are favorable; initial pilot will likely be on-demand/hosted.

I’m copying our procurement mailbox — procurement team, meet Jasmine (AE at Redwood). They sent a TCO and SOW template that should be helpful. Procurement, our priority is: data isolation for customer PII, SOC2 evidence, and an SLA around latency — can you share your intake form and preferred vendor questionnaire?

Tom Bauer
Head of Product — Novus Retail
Tom.Bauer@novusretail.com | +1 312-555-0147

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & hosting alignment

Hi Jasmine — procurement here. Thanks for the materials. A few items to get us started: 

1) Vendor intake form: attached (we often require a completed vendor questionnaire + SOC2 report).
2) Invoice & payment terms: Net 45 preferred. We can issue PO for first-year committed spend; for pilots we'll ask teams to use corporate card.
3) Marketplace: we prefer marketplace but only if commercial terms (discounts, refunds) are equivalent.

Immediate asks for Redwood: please provide the following by end of week so we can initiate legal review:
- SOC2 report (or link to existing attestations)
- Draft SOW showing scope for a 12-month committed Dedicated pool and an alternate for hosted on-demand pilot (pricing anchors)
- Proposed SLA language for p95 latency and data isolation controls

Procurement
Novus Retail — Vendor Management
procurement@novusretail.com

Attachment: NOVUS_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf (stub)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Bauer <tom.bauer@novusretail.com>, Novus Retail Procurement <procurement@novusretail.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & hosting alignment

Aditya / Grace — looping you both in to progress the paperwork and confirm pricing anchors for the SOW. Summary of procurement requirements and our proposed commercial mappings below.

Procurement asks (from Novus): SOC2, SOW for 12-month commit (Dedicated) + alt hosted pilot, SLA for p95 latency, Net45 invoicing option, marketplace OK if terms match.

Our recommended approach to shorten cycle:
- Pilot (immediate): Hosted on-demand, paid by card or trial credits. This gives Novus a proof-of-concept with no procurement gating.
- Production (target): 12-month Dedicated commitment to meet latency and predictable cost. Purchase path: PO + SOW if procurement confirms — we will support Net45 invoicing.
- Marketplace option: Evaluate in parallel; prepare equivalent marketplace listing/pricing but flag any discrepancies. 

Pricing anchors to include in the draft SOW for procurement review:
- Dedicated (12mo committed): baseline $$ per reserved GPU hour, support SLA, and burst capacity add-on — include a 15% commit discount vs on-demand list.
- Hosted (on-demand pilot): per-token and per-embedding rates tied to usage bands; notify procurement that pilot costs are typically higher per unit but no commit required.

Action items: 
1) Aditya: can you generate a draft SOW with the Dedicated 12mo pricing anchor + hosted pilot appendix using the attached SOW template? Include SLA wording for p95 latency and data isolation clauses (KMS and tenant isolation).
2) Grace: please pull our SOC2 attestation link and the standard SLA paragraph. Add the TCO workbook figures (hosted vs dedicated) and mark assumptions.
3) Jasmine: I’ll follow up with Novus procurement to confirm PO owner and expected internal review timeline.

I’m tagging the attachments we will send: Redwood_SOW_template.pdf, Redwood_TCO_hosted_vs_dedicated.xlsx. Also planning a 30-min call next Tue to walk procurement through the SOW if they prefer.

Thanks — aiming to have the draft SOW and SOC2 link ready by Mon EOD.

—
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
